definitions.candidate_run: longest unchanged best non-Base option, even when Base is overall argmax
definitions.moving_average: trailing-free valid-window mean; reported statistic is its maximum
definitions.ranking: descending competition rank among the four requested stable groups only
definitions.top5_mean: mean of the five largest action scores
definitions.trend: OLS slope over the last up-to-10 trace actions ending at trigger, collision, or trace end for no-event controls
